# Two bodies each declaring `Local`, `Phase` and `Tick`, compiled and run as Go
# (#198).
#
# The golden in testdata/body_local_type_two_bodies.txtar says what the three
# renamed declarations look like; this says the file Go is handed actually
# builds. That is the half the goldens cannot state: before passHoistBodyTypes
# `sngl generate` exited 0 on a model.go holding `type Local struct` twice, and
# every assertion in the suite was about text that had been written to disk
# rather than about code anyone had compiled.

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'PASS'
! stdout 'FAIL'

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:test"
import . "sngl:ui"

component first node {
    struct Local {
        a int
    }
    enum Phase {
        start
        done
    }
    unit Tick {
        beat
    }

    var here = Local{a=1}
    var p = Phase.done
    var elapsed Tick = 3beat
    var mark = 0

    effect(@mount {
        mark = here.a
    })

    text(value="{here.a}{elapsed}")
    if p == Phase.done {
        text(value="done")
    }
}

component second node {
    struct Local {
        bField string
    }
    enum Phase {
        ready
    }
    unit Tick {
        span
    }

    var here = Local{bField="two"}
    var p = Phase.ready
    var elapsed Tick = 5span
    var mark = ""

    effect(@mount {
        mark = here.bField
    })

    text(value="{here.bField}{elapsed}")
    if p == Phase.ready {
        text(value="ready")
    }
}

component main node {
    first()
    second()
}

func testFirstKeepsItsOwnLocal(t Test, c first) {
    t.assert(c.mark == 1)
}

func testSecondKeepsItsOwnLocal(t Test, c second) {
    t.assert(c.mark == "two")
}

window {
    main
}
